units: Page lengths are dmm, 0.1 mm, measured from the page top-left unless a name ends in Px or In. Image points are pixels, with pixel (u, v) at (u, v), the convention OpenCV reports marker corners in.

mapping.form: page = normalisedToPage(u (1 + k1 r^2 + k2 r^4)), u = (image - centre) / scale

mapping.model: generalised cylinder through a camera with radial distortion
mapping.form: sheet = along-ruling * (cos a, sin a, 0) + X(t) * (-sin a, cos a, 0) + Z(t) * (0, 0, 1), where (X, Z) integrates (cos, sin) of the tangent angle sum bend[k] (t / 1000)^k along arc length t across the rulings; image = distort(project(R sheet + T))
